text: 中微公司今日在上海临港举行总部大楼落成暨22周年庆典，公司在临港的研发加生产格局正式形成。中微公司董事长尹志尧现场透露，公司已在上海临港、金桥，南昌及在建的成都、广州布局五大研发生产基地，当前整体建筑面积达60万平方米，预计未来5年左右增至90万平方米，届时整体生产能力将超过700亿元。 (科创板日报）
text_en: AMEC held the completion ceremony of its headquarters building and its 22nd anniversary celebration today in Shanghai Lingang, formally establishing an R&D-plus-production layout there. AMEC Chairman Yin Zhiyao disclosed on-site that the company has set up five R&D and production bases in Shanghai Lingang, Jinqiao, Nanchang, and under-construction sites in Chengdu and Guangzhou, with a total building area of 600,000 square meters. That is expected to grow to 900,000 square meters in about five years, when overall production capacity will exceed RMB 70 billion. (STAR Market Daily)
